tasks.short: Explain contract provision changes to customers

steps.what: Compare the actual previous and revised contract provisions
Determine what the changed provisions mean for the customer's benefits, obligations and uncertainties
outputs: actuary's explanation of the changes and implications

steps.what: Explain the changes in contract provisions to the customer and clarify questions
inputs: actuary's explanation of the changes and implications

tasks.design: Use the native version comparison in {CLM} to locate literal provision changes. The actuary interprets their meaning and explains them personally; a text comparison does not decide contractual effect or change the contract.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual comparison of versions distracts from explaining the material changes.
tasks.enabler_now: Native redlines can expose additions and deletions directly.
tasks.still_hard: A small wording change may have a substantial effect in the customer's circumstances.
tasks.human_edge: Explain uncertainty clearly and recognize when specialist contract advice is needed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native contract comparison can locate literal text changes without interpreting their effect.

assumptions: Boundary is source comparison, interpretation and verbal explanation. No separate letter, send or contract amendment is performed.

Contract owner supplies the actual previous and revised version with contract ID and effective date; customer owner supplies existing context. Unmatched versions are manually reconciled in s1, not inferred.
Test native comparison first. Shares and reduction are provisional scenarios; gross 15 minus 1 upkeep gives 14 net. Interpretation and customer discussion are fully retained.
unknowns: Current comparison tooling and version quality
research_questions: Can native comparison reduce version-reading effort without hiding moved clauses or schedules?

already_counted.description: Verify literal changes against both source versions

incremental.description: Check comparison behavior when contract formats change

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where native redlines are already used; up to 10% when difficult versions reduce central 14% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Manage credit and advise on security offering prices

steps.what: Review existing credit exposures, financial information and relevant market inputs
Manage credit by evaluating exposure, credit quality and exceptions with responsible finance colleagues
outputs: actuarial credit assessment and escalation advice

steps.what: Help price corporate security offerings by assessing valuation outputs, assumptions and market uncertainty

tasks.design: Configure a native exposure and valuation reference view in the treasury analysis system {OTHER}, linked to existing financial data in {ERP}. The actuary retains credit assessment and offering-pricing advice; the view does not change limits, execute trades or publish offering terms.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant financial and exposure context can require several views.
tasks.enabler_now: Native treasury views can bring existing inputs together.
tasks.still_hard: Market conditions and issuer quality can invalidate a plausible model output.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge assumptions and decide when to escalate uncertainty.

ambition.what: No new trading or credit-approval authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-7; treasury data access and applicable consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: treasury analysis views can consolidate existing inputs while credit and security-pricing judgement remain professional work.

assumptions: OTHER is treasury and valuation analysis software. Model the actuary's advisory credit-management and pricing role; no limit change, trade, purchase or offering release is performed.

Treasury supplies existing instrument IDs, exposures, valuation dates and market inputs; finance supplies statements. s1 verifies sources and missing dates manually. No free new structured feed or capture is assumed.
Native views first. Shares are provisional scenarios; gross 3.5 minus 0.5 upkeep leaves 3 net. Existing valuation runtime earns no labour saving, and all credit/pricing judgement remains retained.
unknowns: Actual exposure navigation burden and local decision rights
research_questions: Does a native view reduce source navigation while clearly showing stale valuations and missing exposure?

already_counted.description: Verify source exposure and pricing context

incremental.description: Maintain source references and valuation-date checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where inputs are already consolidated; up to 2% with smaller navigation gains than central 3% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Give actuarial expert testimony in court

steps.what: Testify in court as an expert witness or provide legal evidence on matters such as potential lifetime earnings after disability or death
inputs: actual expert analysis and its source evidence
outputs: actuary's oral expert testimony and clarified limitations

tasks.design: Keep expert testimony and answers under examination with the actuary. Evidence references in {DOCS} may support preparation, but no software change is shown to reduce the actual testimony in this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The witness must explain and defend the actual analysis under questioning.
tasks.enabler_now: Document tools assist reference access without replacing accountable testimony.
tasks.still_hard: Explain limitations accurately when a question contains a misleading premise.
tasks.human_edge: Exercise independent professional judgement and answer the court's actual question.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: oral expert evidence depends on the witness's accountable interpretation and response to questioning.

assumptions: Boundary is the stated act of testifying and providing oral expert evidence. No separately authored expert report, filing or send is established; if local work includes one, decompose and measure it rather than fold it into testimony.
Inputs are actual prior analysis and questions, not an assumed new structured record. Native document reference tools were considered but do not establish less testimony time.
No software or process change means zero upkeep. The full share describes the oral task boundary, not a measured court duration.
unknowns: Whether the local task also includes an authored written evidence submission
research_questions: Observe any distinct report-writing or filing action and assess it separately from oral testimony.

incremental.description: No introduced tool, recording or evidence process

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual expert testimony stays fully retained; no separate written-evidence workload is established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The actuary retains interpretation, credit and pricing judgement and expert testimony; native views assist source comparison and navigation.
skills_to_grow: Challenge stale market and valuation inputs
role.ambitious_version: Clearer, source-grounded advice with professional accountability retained.
